bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 10月15日低点

read.en: Corning fell 4.6% on Oct 16 to $132.00 and is down 16% in five sessions. It is below all its averages: the 5-day ($141.4), 10-day ($150.8), 200-day ($153.6) and the falling 30-day ($154.3) and 100-day ($167.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero with the histogram widening, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($164.4), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 康宁 10月16日下跌 4.6%，收于 $132.00，五个交易日累计下跌 16%。股价位于所有均线下方：5 日（$141.4）、10 日（$150.8）、200 日均线（$153.6）以及下行的 30 日（$154.3）和 100 日均线（$167.0）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图继续扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$164.4），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The Oct 15 low ($132.75) broke on the close after a day's low of $131.63; it now caps at $132.75, then $139.3 (Sep 3 low) and $141.4 (5-day average, Aug 24 low). Support is $130 (Jul 30 low), then $122.6 (Jul 29 low) and $114.5 (Jul 28 low). A close below $130 would open $122.6; a close back above $139.3 would target $141.4.
